verdict.rationale: Jules documents that it creates a PR automatically upon task completion (jules-docs-8), and the API exposes an `automationMode` field to configure automatic PR creation for custom workflows (jules-docs-11, jules-docs-9), with community evidence confirming users receive PRs from completed tasks (jules-comm-12, jules-comm-16). Missing for 10: independent verification of the exact automationMode configuration options/reliability and more detailed docs on failure modes of auto-PR creation.
